prompt: Any authenticated user, including someone who is not a member of an organization, can add themselves as an owner of an organization that is not configured for single sign-on, taking it over, or can remove that organization's legitimate owner. The endpoints that add and remove organization members authorize the caller incorrectly. Add the missing authorization so that only a caller permitted to manage the organization can change its membership. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: organization member add remove authorization check
non-SSO org authorization gate returns ok true
how organization management permissions are enforced
